div.div: دَغَمٌ and ↓ دُغْمَةٌ , in a horse, [and in some other animals, (see أَدْغَمُ,)] A colour inclining to blackness, (S, K,) in the face and the part next the lips, (S,) or in the face and the lips, (K,) differing from, (S,) or blacker than, (K,) the colour of the other parts of the body. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
